facts.fact: The NIA statement says it supports banking, healthcare and taxation services, as well as telecoms, in verifying identity against the Ghana Card.
A new SIM registration framework with Ghana Card verification, app self-registration, facial recognition and liveness detection was welcomed by the NIA Executive Secretary on 20 March 2026.
